summary: Implemented the Lambda transform feature. Added Lambda (array, monai/transforms/utility/array.py) which applies a user-supplied callable and raises TypeError for non-callables. Added Lambdad (dictionary, monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) which applies one callable, or a per-key list of callables, to each key, plus LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases. Added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py, and a Lambdad autodoc entry in docs/source/transforms.rst. Tests were not run, per instructions, so they are unverified. Nothing was committed.
